description: The line plot illustrates the average repetition rate across different relation categories for various experimental configurations, with the x-axis representing the "Relation Category" ranging from 0 to 65 in increments of 5, and the y-axis showing the "Average Repetition Rate" on a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.6. The plot includes five distinct lines: a solid blue line labeled "w/o DPO obo," a solid orange line labeled "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint," a solid green line labeled "DPO," a dashed blue line labeled "Average of w/o DPO obo," and a dashed green line labeled "Average of DPO." The "w/o DPO obo" line exhibits significant fluctuations, peaking at approximately 0.61 around relation category 0 and showing other notable peaks near 0.45 around category 25 and 0.35 around category 40. The "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" line also shows high variability, with a peak near 0.6 around category 32 and another around 0.5 around category 62. The "DPO" line is relatively stable, fluctuating between approximately 0.1 and 0.2, with a peak near 0.25 around category 25. The "Average of w/o DPO obo" line, represented by the dashed blue line, remains relatively flat, hovering around 0.2, with a slight dip near category 65. The "Average of DPO" line, represented by the dashed green line, is also stable, staying close to 0.15. The plot includes annotations for specific values: 0.227 for the "w/o DPO obo" line, 0.163 for the "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" line, and 0.117 for the "DPO" line, indicating the average repetition rates for these configurations.
